request: Fix cli-hierarchy down so a bare session name stops only that session instead of the whole hierarchy.
author: dominique

decisions.summary: What should down do with a bare session name?

options.description: Resolve it to the matching roster session and stop only that one
Refuse the call with a one-line error naming the valid forms

decisions.rationale: The operator meant that session; stopping everything on a typo is the failure to remove.

decisions.summary: What if the name matches no roster session?

options.description: Fall back to stopping the whole hierarchy

decisions.rationale: An unknown name must never widen the blast radius of the call.

decisions.summary: In what order does a full down stop the sessions?
decisions.rationale: The planner must outlive the sessions it coordinates so their tasks are requeued.
